title: A Study of the Efficacy of the Code Stroke in Spain
brief_summary: Code Stroke is a system for the rapid identification, pre-notification and transport of acute ischemic stroke patients. The objective of this study was to define quality indicators and to compare treatment outcomes in hospitals where Code Stroke has been implemented and hospitals without the use of Code Stroke (control patients).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* acute ischemic stroke in-patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who refuse participate
